Usage: tool settle (--keep=MACHINE | --delete) <target> [flags]

Settle a file both machines changed.

Arguments:
  <target>              Path to settle.

Flags:
      --keep=MACHINE    Keep this machine's copy.
      --delete          Delete the file on both machines.
      --retries=INT     Attempts before giving up (default: 3; env: $CLIKIT_TEST_RETRIES).

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help            Show context-sensitive help.
      --json            Print one JSON object instead of text.
      --home=HOME       Root of the registry (default: ~/.local/state/tool; env: $CLIKIT_TEST_HOME).

Constraints:
  Exactly one of --keep, --delete.

Output:
  --json prints one object; text otherwise.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run
  5    done, but some repositories need attention
